purpose: Native-thinking analogue of the one-example NIAH-counting.html restoration walkthrough
selection_rule: metadata-only confirmation case with a complete ten-item trace and supported explicit rank/city grammar

intervention.baseline: replace every registered prompt record and parsed trace item with same-length ordinary prompt text
restores: one full clean item span at occurrence k
one grammar-aware clean counter carrier at occurrence k
an equal-token ordinary-state control at the same carrier positions
intervention.layer_mode: cumulative clamp from the frozen source layer through the final decoder block

reporting: show all k=1..10 paths and raw effect-size diagnostics; do not report a p-value, confidence interval, or population claim
